description: For jobsite safety, this checklist records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

blocks.guidance: Verify the jobsite safety condition before marking.
items: Verify energy-isolation, lockout and tagout, and zero-energy confirmation
Inspect scaffold tags, guardrails, ladder setup, anchorage, and fall-arrest rescue plan
Confirm trench protective system, spoil setback, atmospheric test, and competent-person release
Control silica, welding fumes, hot work, combustion exhaust, and respiratory exposure
Establish barricades, spotters, swing-radius exclusion, traffic control, and pedestrian detours
Locate emergency eyewash, extinguishers, first aid, muster point, and rescue contacts
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Pair each jobsite safety result with a finding.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Stop work for uncontrolled energy, fall exposure, excavation instability, missing protection, or imminent danger. Route unresolved jobsite safety work for review.

items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority

title: Jobsite Safety Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
